items.markdown:
**Yes, mezcal can give you a hangover** , especially if you drink too much or drink it quickly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXvNFdB0Pr8zhcRjGvwaYMMyxRbtoBesocZZc3EXn1C7HiEACqtAz7ywqsZjf7Lc4smMZ8ezaIfUf0mg2TFJqHiaNn-6-NnbWEwk7si8rG4j131ynRc7W9lL-jxJAjwVAiy6dXh5eeE8-bHpfqyOBe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13P02xGS4oNnEvP9fqze5HA0AVQ9k2z_BtdoYYTSmEUwCJdGi3slJ9UfTZXr6LIR0xzR5MJ77otDYj-zEmpwEFY98BTF07zBTuFYDQ8ZCt-69Ae6zCBKzpMNp3uUsvpoH9UiMZMeQU1tdoHqAAj259oSuCwiW6YYkgT-FwBgwFM)

While many people claim mezcal causes milder hangovers than other spirits, ethanol itself is the main driver of hangover severity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXvNFdB0Pr8zhcRjGvwaYMMyxRbtoBesocZZc3EXn1C7HiEACqtAz7ywqsZjf7Lc4smMZ8ezaIfUf0mg2TFJqHiaNn-6-NnbWEwk7si8rG4j131ynRc7W9lL-jxJAjwVAiy6dXh5eeE8-bHpfqyOBe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13P02xGS4oNnEvP9fqze5HA0AVQ9k2z_BtdoYYTSmEUwCJdGi3slJ9UfTZXr6LIR0xzR5MJ77otDYj-zEmpwEFY98BTF07zBTuFYDQ8ZCt-69Ae6zCBKzpMNp3uUsvpoH9UiMZMeQU1tdoHqAAj259oSuCwiW6YYkgT-FwBgwFM)

### Why People Say Mezcal Causes Fewer Hangovers

- **No added sugars or additives:** Quality mezcal is made purely from agave and water without artificial sweeteners or color additives.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXvNFdB0Pr8zhcRjGvwaYMMyxRbtoBesocZZc3EXn1C7HiEACqtAz7ywqsZjf7Lc4smMZ8ezaIfUf0mg2TFJqHiaNn-6-NnbWEwk7si8rG4j131ynRc7W9lL-jxJAjwVAiy6dXh5eeE8-bHpfqyOBe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXDjOMb2hKKk4OFBl0VRMwUQnw1zgd7VTL7igd1QwV9PDAVa9otZIMrtETUrCCDNLkRBkf8hiHMKNyMEg18h6CGH7DqzHjfA73yEVlcIvR36MaPMBIF5bAPwnEB6hd0pkAs8eAHKBfaHfJG4W6KkqCBycI-L2ucsQgPg)
- **Careful distillation:** Skilled producers cut out excess heads and tails during distillation, which helps limit unwanted byproducts like methanol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1yg037PTp8cj_q4xBeVhwOgkmotrJ6EJ81CbFQqKHRolY4aYUwLO92szxhN89qtPVDyqd-lTNessXfH7lZl-ACWyGwiUGog9NM6gCZ2pFJFaUHJ2-hOACfqfkSB92_BDy3uoEl658cNiR_EhnIgVSzL7aDIdFOHS55Lr0yuFVG1UEJxBOYt2n5oRCRw0SVG0iuI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wtD3IIBs04siO0JcuNbBAzTdETr9pDNWhHXILt3qjXiMkn2xK87l8KUEf0i0XX1rCWbjXgfLdybh2F2XvqCIICvrmOw4zDIusPYkDxvEH2phEcftio8Uc0HL-MD5175oMvyPNPiZ80UttG6PgaJglkoouFtATZWQClhnlQ7BM5MsS4)
- **How it's typically consumed:** Sipping mezcal slowly with food—rather than taking fast shots or mixing it with sugary drinks—helps pace alcohol intake.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1yoshoDLINrYwKAQB8DpGU1qNTP_5147QgmukSb0LJKqCzWERuB9NfKyyiQBPUMGNo5Ojw0E1Va1CWKF9y33iYOqwcnsT7GyeHb7RR-af4fCc_Grj8BV2JuZV9Q-uSbL3RNydUKQfFg4dbg9xoPAVeWGFcJd8Vsz2ouWFhyb)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXvNFdB0Pr8zhcRjGvwaYMMyxRbtoBesocZZc3EXn1C7HiEACqtAz7ywqsZjf7Lc4smMZ8ezaIfUf0mg2TFJqHiaNn-6-NnbWEwk7si8rG4j131ynRc7W9lL-jxJAjwVAiy6dXh5eeE8-bHpfqyOBe)

As noted in an article by [Bon Appetit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF15wZ2E7cg54-PJF00krQ9Wu87xaaQpwDtqGCCoEQOAiW5k0mu6iBFYTDGS4gFTJFQHn-KBx71SjMkI0sVS41QEpkyEAe2zWTzJJ3kJf9fIZ-Xm7XcXGXdXpvlG_m01_4yjhYwUpzrnr4YGesya1gdezvzrAroGHOJ_CQq8ECH8GmsHBeaoXFfbOWw1RRK3_Oe3v2zHLyFIKJG2v5GBdwrFT5bHdYsPP8Ds13_NWRWgX7) , there is no hard science proving mezcal is hangover-free, and drinking too much of any alcohol too fast will still cause one. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1yg037PTp8cj_q4xBeVhwOgkmotrJ6EJ81CbFQqKHRolY4aYUwLO92szxhN89qtPVDyqd-lTNessXfH7lZl-ACWyGwiUGog9NM6gCZ2pFJFaUHJ2-hOACfqfkSB92_BDy3uoEl658cNiR_EhnIgVSzL7aDIdFOHS55Lr0yuFVG1UEJxBOYt2n5oRCRw0SVG0iuI) agree that well-made mezcal with careful distillation and no added sugars can feel easier the next day than some other drinks. Conversely, [Mezcalum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wtD3IIBs04siO0JcuNbBAzTdETr9pDNWhHXILt3qjXiMkn2xK87l8KUEf0i0XX1rCWbjXgfLdybh2F2XvqCIICvrmOw4zDIusPYkDxvEH2phEcftio8Uc0HL-MD5175oMvyPNPiZ80UttG6PgaJglkoouFtATZWQClhnlQ7BM5MsS4) notes that careful distillation lowers methanol, though individual tolerance, food intake, and moderation still matter.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXvNFdB0Pr8zhcRjGvwaYMMyxRbtoBesocZZc3EXn1C7HiEACqtAz7ywqsZjf7Lc4smMZ8ezaIfUf0mg2TFJqHiaNn-6-NnbWEwk7si8rG4j131ynRc7W9lL-jxJAjwVAiy6dXh5eeE8-bHpfqyOBe)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1yg037PTp8cj_q4xBeVhwOgkmotrJ6EJ81CbFQqKHRolY4aYUwLO92szxhN89qtPVDyqd-lTNessXfH7lZl-ACWyGwiUGog9NM6gCZ2pFJFaUHJ2-hOACfqfkSB92_BDy3uoEl658cNiR_EhnIgVSzL7aDIdFOHS55Lr0yuFVG1UEJxBOYt2n5oRCRw0SVG0iuI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wtD3IIBs04siO0JcuNbBAzTdETr9pDNWhHXILt3qjXiMkn2xK87l8KUEf0i0XX1rCWbjXgfLdybh2F2XvqCIICvrmOw4zDIusPYkDxvEH2phEcftio8Uc0HL-MD5175oMvyPNPiZ80UttG6PgaJglkoouFtATZWQClhnlQ7BM5MsS4)Are you trying to **avoid hangovers** when drinking mezcal, or looking for **mezcal recommendations** that tend to sit lighter?
